reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Barbara Harlowe
reviews.text: Keith Rowland has painted numerous rooms in our home and he always does a great job. He uses the highest quality of paint and does the job in a professional and timely manner. He has transformed most of the rooms in our home and we are so pleased with the outcome. I have recommended Keith to family members and friends and they thank me for giving them Keith’s contact information. He also charges very good prices for his painting services. We have also had Keith provide handyman services such as changing out light fixtures, changing out outlets and hanging blinds. His fee for these services is also very reasonable and done in a safe and professional manner. I highly recommend Rowland Painting.

reviews.author: Nancy Bowman
reviews.text: Keith painted the entire interior of our home in 2019 and it still looks great 4 years later. He also did light carpentry, and beautifully corrected the botched mess the bathroom contractor made in painting the master bath. He was back this year to repaint a spare bedroom we’re converting to an office. He is honest, prompt, professional and reasonable. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nancy Snyder
reviews.text: A few years ago Mr Rowland repaired our front steps and painted the outside of our house. He did a fantastic job. More recently, he repaired our kitchen ceiling and painted the kitchen. He does beautiful work. I couldn't believe how great our kitchen looked. I would never hire anyone else to paint at our house. He's the absolute best!

reviews.author: Judy Cherry
reviews.text: I have been with dealing with Mr. Rowland for 14 years. His work is high quality and he is an honest person relating to what he can and cannot do. His standards are high and he is ALWAYS on time. Could not ask for a better painter. I have referred him to several of my friends. Professional in all ways.

reviews.author: Terry Klimek
reviews.text: Always does an excellent job for a fair price. Highly recommend! Hanging custom shades Backsplash Hanging doors Wallpaper removal and painting

reviews.author: Donna Mayes
reviews.text: Over several years, we've used Keith to paint our privacy fence, nearly all of our home's rooms, and our kitchen cabinets. Today he finished a two-day job painting our gutters, soffits, and downspouts. Every time he has been prompt, professional yet friendly, flexible with our last-minute requests, and efficient, usually finishing before the estimated time frame. His work is great and his price is very reasonable. As long as Keith is around, we will use him for our painting needs. We would recommend him to anyone.
